arabic: + آجِيُوس أُوثِيئُوس: آجِيُوس إِس شِيرُوس: أَجِيُوس أَثَانَاطُوس: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ قُدُّوس اَللهِ قُدُّوس: قُدُّوس اَلْقَوِيُّ قُدُّوس: قُدُّوس اَلْحَيُّ اَللهُ: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ بِمَعُونَةِ رَبٍّ قَدِير: إِلَهٍ عَظِيمٍ خَبِير: أَشْرَح مَعْنَى تَفْسِير: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ مَعْنَاهُ يَامَا أَحْلَاه: لَيْسَ غَيْر اَللهِ إِلَه: نُسَبِّحُهُ فَوْقَ أَعْلَى سَمَاه: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ مِيخَائِيل وَغَبْرِيَال: رَافَائِيل وَسُورِيَال: يَتْلُونَ تَسَابِيح وَأَقْوَال: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ تَسْبِحَة اَلشِّيرُوبِيم: وَأَيْضاً اَلسِّيرَافِيم: قَائِلِينَ بِصَوْتٍ عَظِيم: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ أَجْنَاد نُورَانِيَّة: وَطُغْمَات رُوحَانِيَّة: يَصِيحُونَ عَلَانِيَة: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ رِبْوَات رِبْوَات وَأُلُوف: مِنْ حَوْل اَلْعَرْش صُفُوف: يَقُولُونَ وَهُمْ وُقُوف: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ وَاَلْأَرْبَعَة اَلْكَائِنَات: مِنْ تَحْت اَلْعَرْش ثَبَات: يَتْلُونَ كُلَّ اَلْأَوْقَات: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ اَلْأَوَّل شِبْه أَسَد: صُورَة مِنْ غَيْر جَسَد: وَأَعْيُن بِلَا عَدَد: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ اَلثَّانِي شِبْه اَلثَّوْر: وَهُوَ مَنْظَر مِنْ نُور: يَصِيح بِلَا فُتُور: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ اَلثَّالِث شِبْه عُقَاب: يَسْأَل عَنْ اَلطَّيْر بِإِيجَاب: أَمَام وَحِيد اَلْآب: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ اَلرَّابِع شِبْه إِنْسَان: يَسْأَل عَنَّا اَلْغُفْرَان: أَمَام اَللهِ اَلدَّيَّان: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ مَنْظَر بِالنُّور: مُكَسَّى يُسَبِّحُونَ فِي ات هِيمْسِي: مِنْ فَوْق أَعْلَى اَلْكُرْسِي: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ مَنْظَر بِأَنْوَاعٍ شَتَّى: سِيرَافِيم بِأَجْنِحَةٍ سِتَّة: يَصِيحُونَ بِلَا سَكْتَة: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ وَاَلْأَرْبَعَة وَاَلْعِشْرُونَ: كَهَنَة بِمَقَامٍ نَفِيس: يَصِيحُونَ بِاَلتَّقْدِيس: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ وَتُسَبِّحهُ اَلْأَفْلَاك: اَلَّذِينَ سَلَكُوا اَلْأَسْلَاك: مِنْ فَوْق أَعْلَى اَلسَّمَاوَات: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ سَطَانَائِيل قَدْ صَار: شَيْطَاناً بِاَلِاسْتِكْبَار: لَمَّا بَطَلَ هَذَا اَلتَّذْكَار: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ مِسْكِين مَنْ يَسْمَعُهَا: فِي حَضْرَة قَائِلِهَا: وَلَا يَتْلُو مَعَهَا: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ اَللَّيلُويَا تَسْبِيح: وَتَرْتِيل وَمَدِيح: بِهَا نَصْرُخ وَنَصِيح: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ اَللَّيلُويَا تَمْجِيد: لِإِلَهٍ عَظِيمٍ مَجِيد: وَهُوَ تَذْكَار عَظِيم فَرِيد: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ اَللَّيلُويَا تَنْزِيه: وَقَائِلُهَا يَكْفِيه: يَقُول أَلْفَيْن بِفِيَّة: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ اَللَّيلُويَا بَهْجَة: وَهِيَ أَحْلَى لَهْجَة: وَقَائِلُهَا يَنْجَى: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ اَللَّيلُويَا تَعْظِيم: لِإِلَهٍ رَؤُوفٍ رَحِيم: خَفِيِّ اَلْأَلْطَافِ كَرِيم: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ اَللَّيلُويَا تَذْكَار: لِإِلَهٍ عَظِيم: سَتَّار يَجِب لَهُ اَلتَّذْكَار: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ اَللَّيلُويَا تَرْتِيل: وَتَسْبِيح وَتَهْلِيل: وَهِيَ أَفْضَل مَا قِيل: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ سُبْحَانَهُ مُكَوِّن مَا كَان: كَائِن قَبْلَ اَلْأَكْوَان: مَا يَخْلُو مِنْهُ مَكَان: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ سُبْحَانَهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاه: خَفِيٌّ لَا عَيْن تَرَاه: وَلَا مَعْبُود سِوَاه: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ سُبْحَانَهُ خَلَقَ مِنْ اَلْمَاءِ: نَاراً وَأَرْضاً صَمَّاء: أَوْجَدَهَا مِنْ اَلْعَدَم: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ سُبْحَانَهُ رَبٌّ غَيُور: رَؤُوف رَحِيم غَفُور: عَلَى كُلِّ فِعْلٍ سَتُور: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ بِاَللَّيلُويَا قَدْ صَار: تَحْقِيق بِرِّ اَلْأَبْرَار: قُولُوا أَيُّهَا اَلْحُضَّار: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ دَاوُد بِهَا تَنَبَّأ: وَبِفَضْلِهَا أَنْبَأ: بِأَقْوَالٍ مُنْتَسِبَة: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ فِي شَرْح كِتَاب اَلْمَزْمُور: اَلْمِائَة وَاحِد وَخَمْسِين مَزْمُور: وَفِي آخِر كُلِّ مَزْمُور: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ تُقْرَأ سَائِر اَلْأَوْقَات: إِلَى خَالِق اَلسَّمَاوَات: وَفِي شَرْح اَلْهُوسَات: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ وَقِسْمَة لِلْقُرْبَان: هِيبِي إِفْكِي نِيمَان: وَفِيهَا شَرْح اَلْإِيمَان: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ مَدْح دَاوُد اَلْبَار: مَرْيَم سَيِّدَة اَلْأَبْكَار: عَلَى اَلْعَشَرَة اَلْأَوْتَار: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ بِاَلْأُرْغُن وَاَلْقِيثَار: وَاَلصُّنُوج وَاَلْأَوْتَار: وَاَلدُّفّ مَعَ اَلْمِزْمَار: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ قَالَ يَا اِبْنَة رَبِّك: اِخْتَارَكِ وَأَحَبَّكِ: أَصْغِي وَانْسَي شَعْبَكِ: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ وَعَنْهَا أَيْضاً قَالَ: هِيَ جَبَل اَللهِ اَلْعَال: أَعْلَى مِنْ كُلِّ مِثَال: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ وَسَمَّاهَا صِهْيَوْن: وَقَالَ سَوْفَ يَكُون: إِلَه سِرُّهُ مَكْنُون: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ وَسَمَّاهَا بِاَلْجُمْلَة: اَلْمَلِكَة اَلْمُشْتَمِلَة: بِاَلنُّور وَاَلْحُلَّة: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ وَقَالَ جَمِيع اَلْأُمَم: تُصَفِّق بِتَرَاتِيل وَهِمَم: يَتْلُونَ تَسَابِيح بِنَغَم: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ وَقَالَ طُوبَى لِلْإِنْسَان: اَلْمُتَعَطِّف بِاَلْإِحْسَان: عَلَى اَلْبَائِس وَاَلْمُهَان: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ فَإِنَّ اَلرَّبَّ يُنَجِّيه: وَمِنْ اَلْخَيْرَات يُعْطِيه: مَا يَكْفِيه وَيُعَافِيه: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ يَا رَبُّ إِلَيْك نَسْأَل: اِحْفَظ اَلْبَابَا شَنُودَة اَلْأَمْثَل: بَطْرِيَرْكَنَا وَأَعْطِهِ اَلْإِقْبَال: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ يَا رَبُّ طَمِّنَّا: عَلَى اَلسَّاهِرِينَ عَنَّا: مَطْرَانَتَنَا وَأَسَاقِفَتَنَا: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ وَاِحْفَظ يَا رَبَّ اَلْأَرْبَاب: سَائِر كُلِّ اَلْأَحْبَاب: اَلْحُضَّار وَاَلْغِيَاب: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ وَاِحْفَظ قَارِئَهَا: وَاَلشَّارِح لِمَعَانِيهَا: وَاَلْعَامِل بِمَا فِيهَا: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ وَنَاظِمَهَا اِغْفِر لَهُ: خَطَايَاهُ مَعَ زَلَلِهِ: وَبِرَحْمَتِك أَنْعِم: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ يُوحَنَّا مِنْ سَمَنُود: مُسَمَّى وَبِهَا مَوْلُود: يَا رَبُّ تَحَنَّن عَلَيْهِ وَجُد: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ يُقْرَأ مِثْل فَاضَ قَلْبِي: قَوْلاً حَسَناً مُجَلِّي: يَتَحَقَّق بِمُرَاد رَبِّي: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
+ لِسَانِي تَاق يَتَكَلَّم: بِكَلَامٍ مَاهِرٍ مُفْهِم: بِمُرَاد مَنْ هُوَ يَعْلَم: آمِين اَللَّيلُويَا.
english: + Agios Otheos: Agios Ischyros: Agios Athanatos: Amen Alleluia.
+ Holy God: Holy Mighty: Holy Living God: Amen Alleluia.
+ By the help of a mighty Lord: A great and knowing God: I explain the meaning of the interpretation: Amen Alleluia.
+ Its meaning is how sweet it is: There is no god but God: We praise Him above His highest heaven: Amen Alleluia.
+ Michael and Gabriel: Raphael and Suriel: Recite praises and words: Amen Alleluia.
+ The praise of the Cherubim: And also the Seraphim: Saying with a great voice: Amen Alleluia.
+ Heavenly hosts: And spiritual orders: They cry out openly: Amen Alleluia.
+ Myriads of myriads and thousands: Around the throne in rows: They say while standing: Amen Alleluia.
+ And the four living creatures: Beneath the throne in stability: They recite at all times: Amen Alleluia.
+ The first is like a lion: An image without a body: And eyes without number: Amen Alleluia.
+ The second is like a bull: And it is a sight of light: It cries out without weariness: Amen Alleluia.
+ The third is like an eagle: Asking about the birds with certainty: Before the Only-Begotten of the Father: Amen Alleluia.
+ The fourth is like a man: Asking for us for forgiveness: Before God the Judge: Amen Alleluia.
+ A sight in light: Clothed they praise in the heights: From above the highest throne: Amen Alleluia.
+ A sight in various kinds: Seraphim with six wings: They cry out without ceasing: Amen Alleluia.
+ And the twenty-four: Priests of a precious rank: They cry out with sanctification: Amen Alleluia.
+ And the praise of the spheres: Those who walked the paths: From above the highest heavens: Amen Alleluia.
+ Satanail has become: A devil through pride: When this memorial ceased: Amen Alleluia.
+ Wretched is he who hears it: In the presence of its reciter: And does not recite with him: Amen Alleluia.
+ Alleluia is praise: And chanting and eulogy: By it we cry out and shout: Amen Alleluia.
+ Alleluia is glorification: To a great and glorious God: And it is a great and unique memorial: Amen Alleluia.
+ Alleluia is sanctification: And its reciter is satisfied: He says two thousand with ease: Amen Alleluia.
+ Alleluia is joy: And it is the sweetest tongue: And its reciter is saved: Amen Alleluia.
+ Alleluia is exaltation: To a compassionate and merciful God: Hidden in His graces and generous: Amen Alleluia.
+ Alleluia is a memorial: To a great God: A concealer who deserves the memorial: Amen Alleluia.
+ Alleluia is chanting: And praise and rejoicing: And it is the best that has been said: Amen Alleluia.
+ Glory to Him who formed what was: Existing before the universes: No place is void of Him: Amen Alleluia.
+ Glory to Him whose praise is exalted: Hidden no eye sees Him: And no god is worshipped but Him: Amen Alleluia.
+ Glory to Him who created from water: Fire and a silent earth: He brought them into existence from nothing: Amen Alleluia.
+ Glory to Him a jealous Lord: Compassionate merciful and forgiving: Covering every deed: Amen Alleluia.
+ By Alleluia has come: The fulfillment of the righteousness of the righteous: Say O you who are present: Amen Alleluia.
+ David prophesied by it: And foretold of its virtue: With related words: Amen Alleluia.
+ In the explanation of the book of the Psalm: The one hundred and fifty-first psalm: And at the end of every psalm: Amen Alleluia.
+ It is read at all times: To the Creator of the heavens: And in the explanation of the Hosannas: Amen Alleluia.
+ And a fraction for the Eucharist: Hebi efki niman: And in it is the explanation of the faith: Amen Alleluia.
+ The praise of David the righteous: Mary the Lady of virgins: On the ten strings: Amen Alleluia.
+ With the organ and the harp: And the cymbals and the strings: And the tambourine with the flute: Amen Alleluia.
+ He said O daughter of your Lord: He chose you and loved you: Listen and forget your people: Amen Alleluia.
+ And about her he also said: She is the high mountain of God: Higher than every example: Amen Alleluia.
+ And he called her Zion: And said it shall be: A God whose mystery is hidden: Amen Alleluia.
+ And he called her in summary: The Queen who is encompassed: By light and the garment: Amen Alleluia.
+ And he said all nations: Clap with chants and zeal: They recite praises with melody: Amen Alleluia.
+ And he said blessed is the man: Who is compassionate with kindness: To the miserable and the despised: Amen Alleluia.
+ For the Lord shall save him: And from the blessings He shall give him: What suffices him and heals him: Amen Alleluia.
+ O Lord to You we ask: Protect Pope Shenouda the best: Our Patriarch and grant him success: Amen Alleluia.
+ O Lord reassure us: About those who watch over us: Our Metropolitans and our Bishops: Amen Alleluia.
+ And protect O Lord of lords: All the beloved: Those present and those absent: Amen Alleluia.
+ And protect its reader: And the one who explains its meanings: And the one who acts according to what is in it: Amen Alleluia.
+ And its composer forgive him: His sins and his faults: And by Your mercy grant him: Amen Alleluia.
+ John from Samannud: Named and born in it: O Lord have mercy on him and be generous: Amen Alleluia.
+ It is read like My heart has overflowed: A good word clearly: It is fulfilled by the desire of my Lord: Amen Alleluia.
+ My tongue longed to speak: With a skillful and understanding word: By the desire of Him who knows: Amen Alleluia.
